curated.tagline: Supply-chain exposure radar — scans against a compromise catalog
curated.description: Omarchy plugin over Perplexity's bumblebee scanner: diffs installed packages and lockfiles against a known-compromise catalog, auto-refreshes on staleness, and toasts only on NEW exposures — muted exposures stay visible but silent.
highlights: Mute list keeps accepted exposures visible but quiet
Listed on the official Omarchy plugin marketplace
curated.architecture: bumblebee scan → catalog diff → severity-tagged exposure rows → toasts + panel
